aggregated_statement_text: If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the near-term (0-3 years), North Atlantic Council consensus for the counteroffensive fractures; the Russian pretext narrative constrains Allied national force contributions, then the Joint Force's ability to protect restoration of Estonian and Latvian territorial integrity may be degraded resulting in Moderate risk to restoration of Estonian and Latvian territorial integrity in the near-term (0-3 years).

If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the mid-term (2-7 years), North Atlantic Council consensus for the counteroffensive fractures; the Russian pretext narrative constrains Allied national force contributions, then the Joint Force's ability to protect restoration of Estonian and Latvian territorial integrity may be degraded resulting in Moderate risk to restoration of Estonian and Latvian territorial integrity in the mid-term (2-7 years).

If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the long-term (5-15 years), North Atlantic Council consensus for the counteroffensive fractures; the Russian pretext narrative constrains Allied national force contributions, then the Joint Force's ability to protect restoration of Estonian and Latvian territorial integrity may be degraded resulting in Moderate risk to restoration of Estonian and Latvian territorial integrity in the long-term (5-15 years).

If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the near-term (0-3 years), reception and onward movement through Poland slips more than seven days; a host nation restricts transit, overflight or basing and the reception corridor is rerouted; sabotage of the rail and undersea infrastructure interrupts the lines of communication, then the Joint Force's ability to protect force closure and D-Day on time may be degraded resulting in Significant risk to force closure and D-Day on time in the near-term (0-3 years).

If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the mid-term (2-7 years), reception and onward movement through Poland slips more than seven days; a host nation restricts transit, overflight or basing and the reception corridor is rerouted; sabotage of the rail and undersea infrastructure interrupts the lines of communication, then the Joint Force's ability to protect force closure and D-Day on time may be degraded resulting in Significant risk to force closure and D-Day on time in the mid-term (2-7 years).

If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the long-term (5-15 years), reception and onward movement through Poland slips more than seven days; a host nation restricts transit, overflight or basing and the reception corridor is rerouted; sabotage of the rail and undersea infrastructure interrupts the lines of communication, then the Joint Force's ability to protect force closure and D-Day on time may be degraded resulting in Significant risk to force closure and D-Day on time in the long-term (5-15 years).

If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the near-term (0-3 years), a cruise-missile strike on a reception node halts onward movement; Russia widens the war to Alliance territory outside the Baltic States, then the Joint Force's ability to protect preservation of the force may be degraded resulting in Moderate risk to preservation of the force in the near-term (0-3 years).

If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the mid-term (2-7 years), a cruise-missile strike on a reception node halts onward movement; Russia widens the war to Alliance territory outside the Baltic States, then the Joint Force's ability to protect preservation of the force may be degraded resulting in Moderate risk to preservation of the force in the mid-term (2-7 years).

If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the long-term (5-15 years), a cruise-missile strike on a reception node halts onward movement; Russia widens the war to Alliance territory outside the Baltic States, then the Joint Force's ability to protect preservation of the force may be degraded resulting in Moderate risk to preservation of the force in the long-term (5-15 years).

If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the near-term (0-3 years), the armored division fails to make two brigade combat teams combat-ready by C+21; the prepositioned stock issue rate at Powidz falls behind the brigade issue schedule, then the Joint Force's ability to protect force closure and D-Day on time may be degraded resulting in Significant risk to force closure and D-Day on time in the near-term (0-3 years).

If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the mid-term (2-7 years), the armored division fails to make two brigade combat teams combat-ready by C+21; the prepositioned stock issue rate at Powidz falls behind the brigade issue schedule, then the Joint Force's ability to protect force closure and D-Day on time may be degraded resulting in Significant risk to force closure and D-Day on time in the mid-term (2-7 years).

If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the long-term (5-15 years), the armored division fails to make two brigade combat teams combat-ready by C+21; the prepositioned stock issue rate at Powidz falls behind the brigade issue schedule, then the Joint Force's ability to protect force closure and D-Day on time may be degraded resulting in Significant risk to force closure and D-Day on time in the long-term (5-15 years).

If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the near-term (0-3 years), mining and coastal-missile fires close every Baltic sea port of debarkation; escorted throughput on the Baltic sea line of communication falls below the sustainment floor; the Danish Straits are closed to Allied military transit, then the Joint Force's ability to protect operation conducted inside force and sustainment limits may be denied resulting in High risk to operation conducted inside force and sustainment limits in the near-term (0-3 years).

If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the mid-term (2-7 years), mining and coastal-missile fires close every Baltic sea port of debarkation; escorted throughput on the Baltic sea line of communication falls below the sustainment floor; the Danish Straits are closed to Allied military transit, then the Joint Force's ability to protect operation conducted inside force and sustainment limits may be denied resulting in High risk to operation conducted inside force and sustainment limits in the mid-term (2-7 years).

If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the long-term (5-15 years), mining and coastal-missile fires close every Baltic sea port of debarkation; escorted throughput on the Baltic sea line of communication falls below the sustainment floor; the Danish Straits are closed to Allied military transit, then the Joint Force's ability to protect operation conducted inside force and sustainment limits may be denied resulting in High risk to operation conducted inside force and sustainment limits in the long-term (5-15 years).

If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the near-term (0-3 years), Russia conducts a demonstrative nuclear detonation; Russia employs a non-strategic nuclear weapon against Allied forces; strike authorities beyond engaged forces are withheld and the deep fight cannot be shaped, then the Joint Force's ability to protect escalation contained below the nuclear threshold may be degraded resulting in Significant risk to escalation contained below the nuclear threshold in the near-term (0-3 years).

If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the mid-term (2-7 years), Russia conducts a demonstrative nuclear detonation; Russia employs a non-strategic nuclear weapon against Allied forces; strike authorities beyond engaged forces are withheld and the deep fight cannot be shaped, then the Joint Force's ability to protect escalation contained below the nuclear threshold may be degraded resulting in Significant risk to escalation contained below the nuclear threshold in the mid-term (2-7 years).

If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the long-term (5-15 years), Russia conducts a demonstrative nuclear detonation; Russia employs a non-strategic nuclear weapon against Allied forces; strike authorities beyond engaged forces are withheld and the deep fight cannot be shaped, then the Joint Force's ability to protect escalation contained below the nuclear threshold may be degraded resulting in Significant risk to escalation contained below the nuclear threshold in the long-term (5-15 years).

If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the near-term (0-3 years), the Suwalki corridor is closed to Allied ground movement; Belarusian forces are committed and a second front opens on the Lithuanian border, then the Joint Force's ability to protect restoration of Estonian and Latvian territorial integrity may be degraded resulting in Moderate risk to restoration of Estonian and Latvian territorial integrity in the near-term (0-3 years).

If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the mid-term (2-7 years), the Suwalki corridor is closed to Allied ground movement; Belarusian forces are committed and a second front opens on the Lithuanian border, then the Joint Force's ability to protect restoration of Estonian and Latvian territorial integrity may be degraded resulting in Moderate risk to restoration of Estonian and Latvian territorial integrity in the mid-term (2-7 years).

If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the near-term (0-3 years), the mission partner network fails to carry Allied command and control at transfer of authority; liaison and reporting between the corps and the Allied divisions break down, then the Joint Force's ability to protect preservation of the force may be degraded resulting in Low risk to preservation of the force in the near-term (0-3 years).

If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the mid-term (2-7 years), the mission partner network fails to carry Allied command and control at transfer of authority; liaison and reporting between the corps and the Allied divisions break down, then the Joint Force's ability to protect preservation of the force may be degraded resulting in Low risk to preservation of the force in the mid-term (2-7 years).
